resources.string: Stealth sending
Send as Telegram scheduled messages
The message goes to the Telegram server at once as a scheduled message, and the server publishes it after the chosen time. The app may be closed by then.
While the message waits, you can cancel it, move it or send it now from the chat\'s scheduled messages. For files the time grows to leave room for the upload.

This lowers the chance of showing you online but does not guarantee it: the app does not control your other devices or Telegram\'s rules. Secret chats, chats with paid messages, view-once media and live location cannot be scheduled, and the app asks whether to send at once.

A delay under 15 seconds is too short to rely on Telegram scheduled messages: the app waits this time itself and sends an ordinary message. Telegram may show you online, and if the app is closed before sending, the message may not go out.
